From afa27621a28af317523e0836dad430bec551eb54 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Petko Manolov <petkan@nucleusys.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jan 2026 10:48:21 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: usb: pegasus: fix memory leak in update_eth_regs_async()

When asynchronously writing to the device registers and if usb_submit_urb()
fail, the code fail to release allocated to this point resources.

Fixes: 323b34963d11 ("drivers: net: usb: pegasus: fix control urb submission")
Signed-off-by: Petko Manolov <petkan@nucleusys.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260106084821.3746677-1-petko.manolov@konsulko.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/usb/pegasus.c b/drivers/net/usb/pegasus.c
index 81ca64debc5b..c514483134f0 100644
--- a/drivers/net/usb/pegasus.c
+++ b/drivers/net/usb/pegasus.c
@@ -168,6 +168,8 @@ static int update_eth_regs_async(pegasus_t *pegasus)
 			netif_device_detach(pegasus->net);
 		netif_err(pegasus, drv, pegasus->net,
 			  "%s returned %d\n", __func__, ret);
+		usb_free_urb(async_urb);
+		kfree(req);
 	}
 	return ret;
 }
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

### Modifications in Each File

**`drivers/net/usb/pegasus.c`**  
- In the function `update_eth_regs_async()`, added two resource deallocation lines inside the error handling block that executes when `usb_submit_urb()` fails:  
  - `usb_free_urb(async_urb);`  
  - `kfree(req);`  

### Relationship Between Modifications

Both additions are in the same error path of the same function and serve a single purpose: to prevent a memory leak. Previously, when `usb_submit_urb()` failed, the code only logged an error and returned without freeing the previously allocated URB (`async_urb`) and the request structure (`req`). The fix ensures that in case of submission failure, these allocated resources are properly released before returning, matching the cleanup done in the successful completion path.
